answer: Require every agent identity to stake a refundable bond before trading, so a sybil operator pays real cost per account: the ripple of thousands of fakes becomes a funding drain, not free leverage. Let established peers attest behavior on-ledger, with attestation weight decaying as accounts go dormant, so nobody farms reputation once and coasts. At the zenith of demand, scale the bond with congestion, making mass registration ruinous exactly when an attack would matter. Place offenders on a public ledge: slash the bond of accounts caught double-signing, so detection becomes deterrence.
